semiconductor_relevance: High — SIAMC Advanced Materials provides essential materials like graphite and Pyrolytic Boron Nitride (PBN) for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SIAMC Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in high-performance graphite products and advanced materials such as Pyrolytic Boron Nitride (PBN) and Carbon Fiber Carbon (CFC), which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are designed for high-temperature applications and are used in process chamber components and crystal growing materials.
capabilities: Medium grain vibrated molded graphite blocks with excellent thermal shock resistance
Pyrolytic Boron Nitride (PBN) for process chamber components
Carbon Fiber Carbon (CFC) for high-temperature applications
Customized machining services for semiconductor applications
